changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): JsonSchema pattern, split by trust. stringOptions({ pattern }) takes a host RegExp with exactly the 'u' flag, enforced with the built-in matcher and emitted as its source; fromJson refuses a server's pattern by default and admits it only with fromJson(json, { patternValidator }), whose predicate enforces it, so the library never compiles a server-supplied regex. New schemaPatternConstraintKeywords, SchemaPatternValidator, SchemaPatternPredicate and IFromJsonOptions; 'pattern' joins SchemaValidatingKeyword, so a hand-written SchemaKeywordCapabilities table needs a pattern rule.
